caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular clutch purse positioned at a slight angle, with its front side facing the viewer. The purse is primarily a rich reddish-brown color, with a textured pattern resembling reptile or lizard skin. The edges of the purse, specifically the flap, are adorned with ornate silver-toned decorative metalwork that features scrollwork and an emblem at the center. The sides of the purse show some thickness, indicating compartments, and the underside appears to be made of the same reddish-brown material. The background is a plain, light beige with a faint rectangular border drawn around the central image, and there are no other visible objects in the drawing. The artist's signature, "L. STEINBERG," can be seen in small print at the bottom left inside the border.
title: Purse
